$comment: Every part of the design system, for people, the docs site and AI agents. scripts/check.mjs fails when this file and the folders disagree.

components.name: Box
components.description: A surface: padding, background, border, radius and shadow, each from the tokens.

components.name: Stack
components.description: Children in a column, with the same gap between each.

components.name: Inline
components.description: Children in a row, with the same gap between each.

components.name: Text
components.description: Body text in one of the editor's sizes, tones and weights.
components.useInstead: Heading for titles, Tag for a status.

components.name: Heading
components.description: A title. `level` sets its place in the page outline; `size` changes only how big it looks.

components.name: Tag
components.description: A short label for a state or a category, such as Draft or Published.

components.name: Button
components.description: Starts an action: save, publish, add, delete.
components.useInstead: A link component for going to another page.

components.name: TextField
components.description: One line of text, with its label, help and error.

components.name: Grid
components.description: Children in equal columns, with the same gap between each.
components.useInstead: Inline for a row of buttons or tags, Table for rows of data.

components.name: Link
components.description: Goes to another page.
components.useInstead: Button for something that happens on this page.

components.name: IconButton
components.description: A button that shows only an icon. Its label is its accessible name and its tooltip.
components.useInstead: Button for the main action of a screen.

components.name: Checkbox
components.description: One yes-or-no choice.

components.name: ColorPicker
components.description: A colour, typed as a hex colour or chosen in an area of shades and a slider of hues, or from suggested ones.
components.example: <ColorPicker label="Brand colour" pickLabel="Choose a colour" hueLabel="Hue" value={colour} onChange={setColour} />
components.useInstead: Segmented with swatches for a choice among a template's named looks.

components.name: Select
components.description: One choice from a list, with its label, help and error.
components.useInstead: Menu for a list of actions.

components.name: Tooltip
components.description: A short hint shown when a control is hovered or focused.

components.name: Dialog
components.description: A window over the page that must be dealt with before going back to it.
components.useInstead: ConfirmDialog for "are you sure?".

components.name: Menu
components.description: A list of actions that opens from a button.
components.example: <Menu trigger={<IconButton label="More actions" icon={Ellipsis} />} actions={actions} onAction={run} />
components.useInstead: Select for choosing a field's value.

components.name: Tabs
components.description: Views of the same thing, one shown at a time.

components.name: Table
components.description: Rows of the same kind of thing, with a heading for each column.

components.name: Thumbnail
components.description: A small picture beside the words that name it, such as a listing's photo in a list. Decoration only.
components.useInstead: ImagePicker to choose an image.

components.name: Avatar
components.description: A person's photo in a circle, or their initials where they have none. Decoration only: their name is written beside it.
components.useInstead: Thumbnail for a picture of a thing.

components.name: BarChart
components.description: Values side by side as bars, as columns (a run of days) or rows (named things), with one bar able to stand out.
components.example: <BarChart label="Submissions in the last 14 days" bars={days} highlightId={today} />
components.useInstead: Table or Stat for exact figures; Meter for progress toward one target.

components.name: Meter
components.description: How far something is toward a whole, as a bar in the brand's colour with its words above it.
components.example: <Meter label="November target" value={13800} max={20000} valueText="69% of $20,000" />
components.useInstead: Spinner or LoadingState for something still loading.

components.name: Stat
components.description: One figure with what it counts, for the top of a dashboard.
components.useInstead: Tag for a state; Table past four figures.

components.name: Card
components.description: A framed part of a screen with its own heading, such as one section of a long form.
components.useInstead: Fieldset for a few fields that make one value; Stat for a single figure.

components.name: Repeater
components.description: A list a person builds: add an item, fill it in, put the items in order, take one out.
components.example: <Repeater label="Photos" items={items} emptyText="No photos yet" addLabel="Add photo" onAdd={add} onRemove={remove} onMove={move} removeLabel={…} moveUpLabel={…} moveDownLabel={…} />
components.useInstead: Select or Checkbox to choose from a fixed set; Table for rows nobody edits.

components.name: SectionList
components.description: Sections of different kinds in an order a person chooses. Each opens to show its own fields, and has a menu of what else can be done with it.
components.example: <SectionList label="Sections" items={items} openIds={open} onOpenChange={toggle} emptyText="No sections yet" addLabel="Add section" onAdd={pick} onMove={move} onAction={act} moveUpLabel={…} moveDownLabel={…} moreLabel={…} dragLabel={…} />
components.useInstead: Repeater for several of the same small thing; Tabs to switch between views of one thing.

components.name: Board
components.description: Columns of cards, where a card is dragged from one column to another. Each card also has a menu that moves it, for whoever does not drag.
components.example: <Board label="Pipeline" columns={columns} emptyText="Nobody here" onOpen={open} onMove={move} moveLabel={(name) => `Move ${name}`} />
components.useInstead: Table for a list to read or search; SectionList to put things in an order.

components.name: OptionPicker
components.description: A window to choose one thing from a set of named kinds, in groups, each with a line on what it gives and, when it has one, a picture. Choosing closes it.
components.example: <OptionPicker isOpen={isOpen} onOpenChange={setOpen} title="Add a section" closeLabel="Close" groups={groups} onChoose={add} emptyText="No kinds of section yet" />
components.useInstead: Menu for a handful of actions; Select to choose a field's value; ImagePicker to choose a picture.

components.name: Workbench
components.description: A form with what it makes shown large beside it and kept in view: the sections of a page, and the page. With view="whole" the two take the whole window, the form a panel at the side that can be put away.
components.useInstead: Split for a form with a few settings beside it; Grid for things of equal weight.

components.name: PagePreview
components.description: A page of the site as it would look with what is in a form now, in a frame, at a phone's, a tablet's or the full width. The site draws the page; pressing a section on it says which.
components.example: <PagePreview label="The page, as it would look" address={preview.path} draft={JSON.stringify(draft)} width={width} emptyText="Save the page once to see it here." onSectionPress={open} />
components.useInstead: Thumbnail for a picture; a Link that opens a new tab to read the page whole.

components.name: MediaGrid
components.description: A library of pictures to look through, each with its name and a line about it. Opening one says which.
components.example: <MediaGrid label="Photos" items={photos} onAction={open} emptyText="No photos match." />
components.useInstead: ImagePicker to choose an image for a field.

components.name: ImagePicker
components.description: Shows the image a field holds and lets a person choose another from the site's images, or upload a new one, in a window.
components.example: <ImagePicker label="Cover photo" value={photo} images={images} onChange={setPhoto} chooseLabel="Choose a photo" changeLabel="Change" noneText="No photo chosen" dialogTitle="Choose a photo" closeLabel="Close" emptyText="No photos yet" />
components.useInstead: Select to choose from a short list of words.

components.name: Split
components.description: A wide column with a narrow one beside it, which stays in view on a wide screen and follows below on a narrow one.
components.useInstead: Grid for columns of equal weight.

components.name: PageHeader
components.description: The top of every screen: its title, what it is for, and its main actions.

components.name: EmptyState
components.description: What a screen shows where its content will be, before there is any.
components.example: <EmptyState icon={House} title="No listings yet" action={<Button>New listing</Button>} />

components.name: ConfirmDialog
components.description: Asks before doing something that is hard to undo.
components.example: <ConfirmDialog isOpen={isOpen} onOpenChange={setOpen} title="Delete listing?" confirmLabel="Delete listing" cancelLabel="Cancel" tone="danger" onConfirm={remove}>…</ConfirmDialog>

components.name: RichTextEditor
components.description: Text with headings, lists, quotes, bold, italics and links, with its label, help and error.
components.useInstead: TextArea for plain text of several lines.

components.name: TextArea
components.description: Several lines of plain text, with its label, help and error.
components.useInstead: TextField for one line.

components.name: Switch
components.description: A setting that is on or off, and takes effect at once.
components.useInstead: Checkbox for a choice saved later with a form.

components.name: Toast
components.description: Where short messages appear. Put one in the app and call toast() to show a message.
components.useInstead: Dialog for anything that needs an answer.

components.name: CommandPalette
components.description: A window to find anything by typing and go there: a box, and under it the matches in groups.
components.example: <CommandPalette isOpen={isOpen} onOpenChange={setOpen} label="Search and commands" placeholder="Search, jump to or create anything" emptyText="Nothing matches that." groups={groups} onAction={run} />
components.useInstead: SearchField to narrow down one list on a screen.

components.name: Outline
components.description: The parts of something long, by name and in order, with the current one marked. Choosing one goes to it.
components.example: <Outline title="Sections" items={sections} currentId={current} onChoose={goTo} emptyText="No sections yet." />
components.useInstead: SectionList to put sections in order and edit them.

components.name: Welcome
components.description: The top of a screen that greets the person: what matters now in large words, one phrase set apart, what to do first, and the site beside it.
components.example: <Welcome eyebrow="Saturday, 21 November" title="Good morning, Dana. 3 drafts are waiting." highlight="Dana" actions={actions} aside={preview} />
components.useInstead: PageHeader for the top of every other screen.

components.name: SiteWindow
components.description: A page of the site in a small browser window, as visitors see it now. The whole card is one link.
components.example: <SiteWindow address="lakeshore.example" src="/" title="The home page" label="Edit the home page" meta="Published 3 days ago" onPress={edit} />
components.useInstead: PagePreview to see and work on a draft.

components.name: AppShell
components.description: The frame around every screen: the rail of sections, the current section's places beside it, the bar with the search, and the main area.
components.example: <AppShell logoLabel="Velocity" siteName="Lakeshore Realty" navLabel="Main" skipLabel="Skip to content" search={search} nav={groups} account={account}>…</AppShell>

components.name: SaveBar
components.description: The bar that stays at the bottom of an editing screen, with the entry's state and its save buttons.

components.name: Form
components.description: Fields that are sent together, in a column.
components.useInstead: Stack for layout alone.

components.name: Skeleton
components.description: A grey shape standing where something will be once it has loaded. SkeletonGroup says what is loading.
components.useInstead: Button isPending for an action under way; Spinner where there is no layout to keep.

components.name: FileButton
components.description: A button that opens the computer's file chooser and hands back the file that was picked.
components.useInstead: ImagePicker to choose one of the site's images for a field.

components.name: Spinner
components.description: Says that something is on its way.
components.useInstead: Button isPending for an action under way.

components.name: LoadingMark
components.description: The whole screen while the app opens: the Velocity mark in the middle, its facets arriving in grey and taking their colour.
components.useInstead: LoadingState with a shape where the screen's layout is known; Spinner for a part of a screen.

components.name: AuthShell
components.description: The frame around the screens before sign-in: one card in the middle of the page.
components.useInstead: AppShell after sign-in.

components.name: NumberField
components.description: A number, written in the person's own format, with its label, help and error.
components.useInstead: TextField for numbers that are really names, such as a postcode.

components.name: DateField
components.description: A calendar date, typed in the order the person's language writes it.

components.name: Spotlight
components.description: Brings what it holds into view and marks it for a moment, when something elsewhere on the screen pointed at it.
components.useInstead: SectionList's revealId for a row that opens; Toast for news.

components.name: Fieldset
components.description: Several fields that belong together, under one name.
components.useInstead: Heading over a Stack to split a long form into sections.

components.name: Logo
components.description: The Velocity mark, in the brand colour and the text colour.

components.name: Segmented
components.description: A few choices in a row, one always chosen: a filter over a list, or a language.
components.useInstead: Tabs with empty panels to filter a list.

components.name: SearchField
components.description: A box for narrowing down a list by typing, with a button that empties it.
components.example: <SearchField label="Search listings" clearLabel="Clear search" value={query} onChange={setQuery} />
